items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah, but you really set those rhythm patterns, because Ernie Hays and Everett Barksdale. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, and Carl Lynch.

ctx.x: Well, as a contractor. I gave the contracting to somebody else; he wanted me to be the contractor, and I said, I don't want it, and at the time, I gave it to Frank Carroll because I was doing all of Frank Carroll's work. So instead of me making the money, Frank Carroll was making the money and I was getting $5 and a quarter, I think it was at that time.
Yeah, but you really set those rhythm patterns, because Ernie Hays and Everett Barksdale.
